description: This file contains pytest test cases for testing security and authentication features of a FastAPI application, including token validation and OpenAPI schema validation.

classes.name: TestClient
classes.description: FastAPI's test client used to simulate requests to the application.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports a security tutorial module based on request parameters and creates a TestClient for testing.

methods.name: test_no_token(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test case that verifies unauthorized access returns a 401 status and appropriate detail when no token is provided.

methods.name: test_token(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test case that verifies authenticated access with a Bearer token returns a successful response with user data.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test case that verifies the OpenAPI schema returned by the FastAPI app matches expected structure.
